baseline: Private full worktree archive from before Comic Neue, 08.10.2026; no operating-system fonts copied.
method: Read-only DOM computed-style and Range client-rectangle measurements in the same real Mac Chrome browser; original public assets on loopback 8083, current project on 8080. Width and font-loading completion verified per case. Gallery modes explicitly selected and compared like for like. /gewerbekunden/ redirects to homepage.
limitations: Finite tested widths; no proof for every possible viewport or browser.

Rendered glyph source/version was not individually inspected; CSS family alone is not such proof. Earlier user Safari font-inspector observation identified Comic Sans MS at the sampled button; iPhone face remains unconfirmed.
Real Mac Chrome only. Viewport tests are not real iPhone/Pixel/Android or Safari tests.

Viewport-override screenshots were downscaled incorrectly by the available capture path; use DOM measurements for those viewports. Pixel comparison below uses default actual Mac window, 1710 x 929, same zoom.
No complete fresh-cache HAR. Existing Elfsight behavior/settings untouched. No new font source introduced.
Existing qualification text-box overhang at 320 px persists within visible overflow; no new local or horizontal page overflow.
Small glyph-width differences remain. First step heading has an intrinsic inline glyph box about 2-2.5 px shorter despite restored CSS line height; card geometry unchanged.
Existing em-based 0.2em optical padding in the approved Project CTA differs by about 0.43-0.45 px after font size compensation; deliberately retained.

optical_changes.related_traffic_label_letter_spacing: .035em only in related-service lists; other service labels remain .015em
optical_changes.line_height: Divide former unitless value by the role scale, retaining former pixel line-box height; no fixed text heights or forced new line breaks.

screenshot.description: Two unscaled crops of actual browser captures, with explanatory captions; no generated font rendering.
